definitions.gloss: to rise, to go up, to ascend
definitions.explanation: For smoke, steam, mist, or similar things to rise upward. Often used for visual phenomena that drift or billow upward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る。
⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{湯気|ゆげ}→湯気：03991_yuge⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Steam was rising from the hot spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火口|かこう}→火口：00448_kakou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I could see white smoke rising from the volcano's crater.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). The subject (smoke, steam, etc.) rises on its own.

CONJUGATION (godan, る-row):
- Negative: {立|た}ち{上|のぼ}らない
- Te-form: {立|た}ち{上|のぼ}って
- Past: {立|た}ち{上|のぼ}った

ASPECT (ている):
{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates smoke or steam is currently rising (ongoing action).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る: smoke rises
- ⟦{湯気|ゆげ}→湯気：03991_yuge⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る: steam rises
- ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る: mist rises

NOTE: Not to be confused with ⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧ (to stand up, to start up), which has a different reading and meaning.
